title: State machine transition and gain computation tests
description:
Add focused Catch2 (or existing project test harness) unit tests covering PerformanceStateMachine transitions/hysteresis/reopen and GainComputer/GainSmoother math.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and any existing tests/* patterns from prior phases
- Source/DSP/PerformanceStateMachine.*, GainComputer.*, GainSmoother.* public APIs
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 7, 15, 16 formulas under test
- CMakeLists.txt test target registration from c.3 (do not re-own CMake — prefer zero CMake edits)

Implement tests/StateMachineTests.cpp:
1) Hysteresis: with fixed H, T_close == T_open - H; level above T_open enters open-family; level between T_close and T_open does not immediately force Closed after open; level below T_close after hold expiry allows Release/Closed path.
2) Hold: when level drops below open threshold, machine enters/remains Hold until configured hold time elapses at the given sample rate.
3) Reopen: during Release, a valid transient/reopen stimulus transitions to Reopen (or attack/open-family) without requiring a full return through Closed first.
4) Soft decision: for L midpoint between T_close and T_open, smoothstep u≈0.5 and S(u)≈0.5 within stated tolerance.
5) GainComputer hard/soft: high L → near-unity target (above floor); deep noise floor L → near g_floor; soft mode yields intermediate gains near the knee vs hard corners.
6) Expander: for R=2, L = T - 6 dB, G_exp_dB matches max(G_floor_dB, (R-1)*(L-T)) within tolerance; linear gain matches 10^(G_dB/20).
7) Curve shape: gamma=1 linear in S between floor and unity; gamma>1 pulls shaped gain lower for mid S than gamma=1 on the same S fixture.
8) GainSmoother: step-up target uses open tau; step-down uses close tau — after equal sample counts with tau_close >> tau_open, downward wrap residual is larger (slower) than upward approach residual within a deterministic fixture.

Keep tests deterministic (fixed SR, fixed lengths, explicit tolerances). No audio hardware.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/StateMachineTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases for PerformanceStateMachine, GainComputer, and GainSmoother
tests assert T_close = T_open - H and dual-threshold open/hold/close behavior
tests assert Hold respects configured hold time before release/close progression
tests assert Reopen path activates from Release on valid reopen/transient stimulus
tests assert soft-decision smoothstep midpoint behavior within stated tolerance
tests assert GainComputer hard/soft floor/unity targets and expander G_exp_dB = max(G_floor_dB, (R-1)*(L-T))
tests assert curve-shape gamma and GainSmoother separate open/close time constants on step fixtures
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/* production DSP implementations except via test includes
add non-JUCE third-party test frameworks not already used by the project
network access or non-deterministic timing assertions

allowed: use the existing test framework from tests/TestMain.cpp
synthetic level/step fixtures at a fixed sample rate (e.g. 48000)
relative dB/gain tolerances rather than bit-exact equality
forbidden: reimplement DSP inside the test file
require real audio hardware or host sidechain
